trust: External searches only. SAT tables are independently checked. UNSAT reports here are not Lean certificates; UNKNOWN means the allotted search was inconclusive.
normalization: Choose a minimum-rank row as row0, normalize its image to an initial segment, fix its diagonal output to0 or1, and sort inputs outside that image. At rank2 or3 and order12, zero cannot be in the image because the proved edge bound would give12<=rank^2.
rank2_partition: The40 normalized rows are[1,a,b]+[1]*c+[2]*(9-c), a,b in{1,2}, c=0,...,9. The4 initially unresolved cases have6 occurrences of each output; their collision-constraint followups cover those same cases.
rank3_partition: Fix first-row prefix[1,a,b,c], with a in{1,2}, b,c in{1,2,3}. The first-row lexicographic normalization excludes a=3. All18 prefixes are searched independently; any remaining UNKNOWN prevents an exclusion.
